# Platonic Brain Index — leaderboard

*Machine-generated by `python -m pbi leaderboard` from committed kernels; do not edit by hand.*

**PBI = mean over datasets (THINGS-EEG2, THINGS-MEG, THINGS-fMRI-IT) and metrics (mutual k-NN, debiased linear CKA, RSA) of the noise-ceiling-corrected alignment** (corrected = raw / sqrt(split-half ceiling), averaged over subjects). 1.0 = as aligned as the split-half reliability of the brain data allows (for mutual k-NN the correction is a heuristic). `n_cells` = how many of the 9 dataset x metric cells entered the mean; models with fewer cells are not directly comparable. CI = 95% interval over 80% stimulus subsamples. `above null` = cells where the score beats the shuffled-stimulus null (p < 0.05, uncorrected).

Reference rows: `brain_heldout` = a subject scored against the mean of the other subjects (same correction); `consensus` = mean kernel of all trained vision models. Random-init networks are untrained controls.
